BrochureContent.Content:
Blue Sky Property are delighted to bring to the market, this exceptional three-bedroom midterrace Victorian residence, set along the waterfront in the highly soughtafter seaside village of Blackrock, Co. Louth. Marrying original character with a captivating coastal outlook, this is a home of presence and charm, an increasingly scarce opportunity in this seaside village setting. 

Positioned to take full advantage of its beachfront aspect, the property enjoys uninterrupted views across Dundalk Bay to the Cooley Mountains. Accommodation extends over two floors and opens to a rear terrace patio and raised garden, perfect for alfresco dining and sunset vistas over the water.

Inside, the atmosphere is warm and inviting, with an eclectic mix of period features and tasteful furnishings welcomes you at the entrance hallway. Two elegant reception rooms to the front frame everchanging seascapes throughout the seasons, while to the rear a wellproportioned dining room flows to the kitchen, utility, and guest WC. Upstairs, three bedrooms include two with sea views, complemented by a family bathroom. 

This is a wonderful opportunity to secure a period village house in this sought after coastal location with an opportunity to create something truly special. For all Further Details and viewings, contact Blue Sky Property 042 932 9333. Guide Price €485,000. 

Location : Blackrock is one of County Louth’s most desirable coastal villages, celebrated for its picturesque beach, vibrant promenade, and welcoming community. The waterfront is lined with cafés, restaurants, boutiques, and everyday amenities. The village is well served by excellent primary schools and sporting facilities, including Dundalk Golf Club, with the Fairways Hotel nearby. 

Dundalk Town Centre is a 10 minute drive away, while the M1 motorway offers swift access to Dublin and Belfast, making Blackrock an ideal base for commuters and families seeking the best of coastal living and connectivity.

All measurements are approximate, and photographs provided for guidance only.
